info.title: Peacock Academy API
info.description: Contract for the Peacock Academy school management system. Every response uses the standard envelope; the frontend switches on error.code, never on message.

get.summary: Absence notices. Teachers see only their classes

post.summary: A parent reports a child absent for some days. Marks existing absences as excused

get.summary: List admins

post.summary: Create a admin account with a temporary password or an email invite

delete.summary: Remove a admin (soft delete). Ends all their logins

get.summary: One admin
scope=feed: announcements for you, pinned first, with read markers. scope=manage: what you wrote (everything for admins)

post.summary: Post an announcement to everyone, some roles, or some class arms. Teachers post to their own classes only and need approval

patch.summary: Edit an announcement (the author, an admin or the super admin)

post.summary: Approve a teacher's post
Mark an announcement you can see as read

get.summary: How many announcements you have not read
Attendance records. Teachers see only their classes

put.summary: Mark a day's attendance for a class arm. The class teacher (last 14 days) or an admin. Absences covered by a notice become EXCUSED

get.summary: Audit log, read-only, filterable

post.summary: Change own password. Ends all other logins and starts a fresh one. Allowed while a change is required.
Email a single-use reset link. Always answers 200, whether or not the account exists.
Log in with email, phone, staff ID or registration number. Sets the cookies; no token is returned.
End this login
End every login this user has

get.summary: The current user and role

post.summary: Swap the refresh cookie for new cookies. 409 CONFLICT means retry once.
Set a new password with the link from the email. Ends every login. VALIDATION_ERROR on field "token" means the link is invalid or used.

get.summary: A linked child's tasks and deadlines (read-only, without their answers)
List class arms, optionally for one class

post.summary: Create an arm, for example JSS1 A

put.summary: Set the class teacher of an arm. Replaces the previous one

get.summary: List classes, lowest level first

post.summary: Create a class and choose its subjects

patch.summary: Change a class name, level or subject list

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up
List parent-student links. Filter status=PENDING to see claims waiting for approval

patch.summary: Approve a pending claim (ACTIVE) or revoke a link (REVOKED)

post.summary: Claim a child with a code from the school. Pending until an admin approves

get.summary: The parent's own linked children
Your notifications, newest first. Cursor paging: send meta.nextCursor back as cursor
Which channels you get notifications on

put.summary: Turn in-app and email notifications on or off

post.summary: Mark some (ids) or all (all: true) notifications as read

get.summary: How many unread notifications you have
List parents

post.summary: Create a parent account (phone, email or both) with a temporary password or an email invite

delete.summary: Remove a parent (soft delete). Ends all their logins

get.summary: One parent (a parent sees only themselves)

patch.summary: Update a parent. A parent may change only their own address and phone

post.summary: Link a parent to a student. Active at once

get.summary: Readiness: MongoDB and Redis both answer
List requests you can see. Use needsAction=true for your to-do list

post.summary: Create a draft. payload fields depend on type; see request.payloads.ts. Teachers: reviews, incidents, resources, leave. Admins: leave, waivers, refunds, result publication, transfers. Parents: complaints, suggestions

get.summary: One request with its full step history and the actions you may take

patch.summary: Edit a draft, or a returned request, before resubmitting

post.summary: Close without a decision, with a reason
Add a comment
Approve, reject or note, with a comment. The super admin decides escalated requests; an admin decides short leave directly
Escalate to the super admin
Send back to the creator with a comment
Send to the next level. Admin-created requests go straight to the super admin

get.summary: List academic sessions

post.summary: Create a session, for example 2026/2027

patch.summary: Change a session name or dates

get.summary: Score components (for example CA1, CA2, EXAM) and grade bands

put.summary: Replace the scale. Component maximums must add up to 100. Components cannot change once scores exist

get.summary: Staff attendance. Teachers see only their own

put.summary: Mark staff attendance for a day

get.summary: My tasks this session with my status on each
Completion rate, on-time rate, score trend and streak
List students. Teachers see only the classes they teach

post.summary: Admit a student. Returns the registration number and a one-time temporary password

delete.summary: Remove a student (soft delete). Ends all their logins

get.summary: One student (a parent sees only their children, a student only themselves)
One student's attendance with totals (parents: own children, students: themselves)

200.description: Summary and a page of records

post.summary: Make a one-time claim code for a student, to give to a parent. Shown once, valid 14 days

put.summary: Put a student in a class for a session (defaults to the current one)

post.summary: Upload a CSV (field "file", max 2 MB, 1000 rows). Validates every row and returns a report; nothing is saved
Save a clean import. Returns each new registration number and one-time password

get.summary: List subjects

post.summary: Create a subject

patch.summary: Change a subject name or code
GRADE with a score, or RETURN with feedback for resubmission

get.summary: Tasks. A teacher sees their own, an admin sees all

post.summary: Set a task for a subject you teach in a class (current session). The class is notified

delete.summary: Delete a task nobody has submitted to

get.summary: One task

patch.summary: Change a task. The maximum score cannot go below a score already given

get.summary: Every student of the class with their submission status

post.summary: Submit or resubmit my answer. Late work is accepted and flagged. A graded task is final

get.summary: List teachers

post.summary: Create a teacher account with a temporary password or an email invite

delete.summary: Remove a teacher (soft delete). Ends all their logins

get.summary: One teacher (a teacher sees only themselves)

patch.summary: Update a teacher. A teacher may change only their own address and phone

get.summary: List assignments. A teacher sees only their own

post.summary: Give a teacher a subject in a class arm. The class must offer the subject. Defaults to the current session

patch.summary: Hand an assignment to another teacher

get.summary: List terms, filter by session or current

post.summary: Create a term inside a session

patch.summary: Change a term name or dates (not while closed)

post.summary: Close a term. Its details can no longer be edited
Reopen a closed term
Make this term, and its session, the current one
End every login this user has right now
Lock an account and end all its logins. Admins can only act on non-admin accounts

get.summary: Sign-in activity for an account, newest first

post.summary: Set a new temporary password, shown once. Ends all logins and forces a change
Unlock an account (also clears a login-attempt lockout)
